title: CARES: Comprehensive Evaluation of Safety and Adversarial Robustness in Medical LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to synthetic clinical queries and adversarial jailbreak variants (indirect, obfuscated, and role-play) that feature explicit or implicit racial biases in healthcare decision-making, using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify responses as ACCEPT, CAUTION, or REFUSE.
